representative: Obsidian has released a Web Clipper extension to enhance your knowledge management

recent_posts.title: Storybook 8.4 launches with component testing, Svelte 5 support, improved tagging, & more
recent_posts.summary: Storybook 8.4 introduces various enhancements for UI component development, including a 1-click component testing and debugging tool with support for Vitest and other test runners. The update also dramatically reduces install size and lockfile additions, supports Svelte 5, improves TypeScript and JSDoc support, and integrates with React Native Storybook 8. A new tagging mechanism for filtering stories is included, along with numerous improvements and bug fixes.

recent_posts.title: WordPress 6.7 launches with new default theme, Zoom Out feature and improved block editing
recent_posts.summary: WordPress 6.7, named “Rollins” after Sonny Rollins, introduces the new default block theme Twenty Twenty-Five and features like the Zoom Out for high-level content design. Enhancements include improved block editing, better font management, and simplified navigation in the site editor. The update also offers developer and accessibility improvements, as well as better PHP 8+ support.

recent_posts.title: Podman Desktop 1.14 reveals new Kubernetes features
recent_posts.summary: Podman Desktop 1.14 introduces significant improvements for Kubernetes users, including a revamped Kubernetes dashboard, new port forwarding capability for pods, and various enhancements and fixes. Users can explore updated CI checks, improved dashboard navigation, and new learning guides. The release is available for download on the official site and contributions can be made via GitHub.

recent_posts.title: Signal enhances calling features with group call links and improved controls
recent_posts.summary: Signal has introduced new calling features including group call links that do not require an existing group chat, admin controls for participant approval, a raise hand button, and emoji reactions. Group calls can now host up to 50 participants and links can be reused for recurring meetings. Additionally, a dedicated calls tab has been added to Android, iOS, and Desktop platforms, with enhanced participant views and updated call control settings.

recent_posts.title: Microsoft has released F# 9, the next version of its general-purpose programming language
recent_posts.summary: F# 9 introduces key features for enhanced program safety, resilience, and performance, such as a type-safe approach to handling null reference types and auto-generated properties for discriminated union cases. It supports returning `bool` in partial active patterns, resolves extension methods with intrinsic type properties, and includes enhancements to computation expressions and F# Interactive. The update addresses several compiler warnings and improves the standard library, developer productivity, and overall performance.

recent_posts.title: Ecosia and Qwant team up to launch an independent search index, challenging Google & Bing
recent_posts.summary: Ecosia and Qwant are collaborating to create an independent European search index called the European Search Perspective (EUSP), aimed at reducing reliance on Google and Bing. The EUSP will be based in France and available to other tech firms, aligning with EU goals for digital sovereignty. The partnership is supported by the EU's Digital Markets Act, which mandates data sharing necessary for new search models.

recent_posts.title: DaVinci Resolve 19.1 has been launched with improved Multicam Audio & Object Mask Caching
recent_posts.summary: DaVinci Resolve 19.1 has been launched with enhanced multicam audio editing, improved stereo track effects management, and faster object mask caching. The update supports spatial photos and videos on Mac, improves media management with new auto-sync options and export capabilities, and enhances search functions and timeline responsiveness. The Deliver Page has new export options, and Blackmagic Design Fusion 19.1 introduces new titles, effects, and advanced 3D scene export capabilities.

recent_posts.title: Apple introduces Share Item Location to enhance item recovery and airline luggage tracking
recent_posts.summary: Apple has introduced Share Item Location, a new iOS feature to help users find and recover misplaced items through the Find My app. The feature allows location sharing for AirTags and Find My network accessories, which can be viewed on an interactive map via a website. It integrates with the customer service processes of over 15 major airlines for tracking mishandled or delayed baggage. Support for Share Item Location will also be added to WorldTracer, a global baggage-tracing system.

recent_posts.title: Nvidia officially launches its new all-in-one Nvidia App, replacing GeForce Experience
recent_posts.summary: Nvidia has released its new Nvidia App for PC, which replaces GeForce Experience. It comes with a redesigned interface and advanced features like 4K 120fps AV1 video capture, AI-powered overlays, and integrated RTX game filters. The app also consolidates settings from the Nvidia Control Panel and has added functionalities like display settings and RTX Video HDR sliders. Installation is simpler as it's bundled with Game Ready and Studio Ready Drivers. Significantly, the app doesn’t require logging into an Nvidia account.

recent_posts.title: Malwarebytes acquires AzireVPN to enhance security and expand VPN services
recent_posts.summary: Malwarebytes has acquired AzireVPN, a privacy-focused VPN provider. This acquisition aims to enhance security through advanced VPN technologies while maintaining AzireVPN's no-logs policy and dedicated server infrastructure. Users can expect an expansion into new locations, but some have shown concern over recent changes in AzireVPN's privacy policy, especially regarding data transfer in case of mergers or acquisitions.
